_comment: Agent-specific credential allowlist. No secrets here. `item` is the Bitwarden item id or exact item name. `allowedOrigins` are exact origins where the injector may fill this credential. The injector reads the live Playwright page's URL (the tab the model is driving) and fails closed off-allowlist. Optional `steps` drive multi-page logins; each `fill` re-checks origin before typing. `submit` (or the tool's submit arg) clicks `submitSelector` if set, else presses Enter. A `fill` of "totp" pulls the current 2FA code from the Bitwarden item — never shown to the model.
